levels.surface: حسن بن عبد الله بن محمد بن عيسى

notes: The second isnad («حَدَّثَنِي حَسَنُ») comes after the matn and carries the same saying («مثله»): a route, not a variant; its last item is the back-reference «بإسناده» as written
«أبي» is the compiler's own father, a bare relation; the Imam «أبي عبد الله» is written after «عن» inside the chain, so narrator
